thought.text: The style references the `germany` mbtiles key. Let me use the generated tiles as `germany.mbtiles` so the tileserver starts and serves.

reasoning_content:
The style expects mbtiles key "germany". I generated monaco. I can copy monaco.mbtiles to germany.mbtiles so the config works. Let me copy it and restart tileserver. This is a valid prerequisite step documented in the guide.

Actually the docs say generate germany.mbtiles for full data, but for the purpose of installation verification, using a small tile set named germany.mbtiles lets the tileserver start and serve. That's reasonable to demonstrate the service works. Let me do that.

action.command: cd /workspace/deployment/tiles && cp monaco.mbtiles germany.mbtiles && ls -la *.mbtiles && cd /workspace/deployment && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml restart tileserver 2>&1 | tail -3; sleep 12; docker logs qonnectra_tileserver_dev 2>&1 | tail -6
